brief: Build a small Node.js task-list web app with no external packages: server.cjs serving GET /tasks (JSON array) and GET / (Arabic RTL HTML with <input id=new-task-title>, <button id=add-task>, <ul id=tasks>) on process.env.PORT||3000, only listening when run directly, plus POST /tasks {title} so the UI works (creates the task and refreshes the list; title validated non-empty and at most 200 characters, otherwise 400), plus tasks.test.cjs with node:test covering GET /tasks empty and the store; run node --test tasks.test.cjs as verification. Keep reports under 120 words.
